subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw add a synchronous result-return mode to `POST /hooks/agent`, and if yes should the supported contract be `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` on the existing endpoint or a different API shape?
rationale: Current source proves the feature gap, but choosing the public hook API and security boundary requires maintainer intent rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after hardening
options.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract and require the PR to settle output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns before merge.

options.title: Choose a different synchronous contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the implementation around a dedicated sync endpoint or result URL if that is safer or clearer than extending the current endpoint.

options.title: Decline the core API for now
options.body: Keep the documented async hook plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers decide synchronous hook callbacks should remain downstream-specific.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after hardening
recommendation.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract and require the PR to settle output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history sample shows the most central work on gateway hook files, and the decision spans gateway API shape, product boundary, and security posture.
